## Checklist
- [ ] standard library only, no build step, no CDN, no telemetry
- [ ] no personal machine, host, account or project names; fixtures are synthetic or redacted
- [ ] nothing on the board without a real feed field behind it; unknown and stale are shown, never as zero
- [ ] docs and `CHANGELOG.md` updated for any change to what the board says
- [ ] `scripts/self-audit` passes
- [ ] `scripts/merged-check` passes against current `origin/main` (run right before handing off, and again if main moved before merge)
